'''Eric Taylor Air Strike!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Eric Taylor]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Death Star: War Room]]
* '''Strategy:''' Air Strike!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Air Strike! Taylor DS 1997 Designs.txt |Download]]
